name: arrow-trap-prepare-declined-returns-attacking-ally
notes: Arrow Trap (uoQGe5xGDQ): same setup as arrow-trap-prepared-destroy-attacking-ally (champion has one preparation counter, Class Bonus active), but player 1 answers NO to 'Pay Prepare 1?'. Arrow Trap is then NOT prepared, so the Class Bonus 'destroy instead' does not apply: the attacking Dungeon Guide returns to its owner's hand and the preparation counter is kept. Added with the CombatAttacker perspective fix as the correct-path counterpart to the prepared/destroy fixture.

rulesClauses: Prepare 1 is optional: declining it leaves Arrow Trap unprepared.
Return target attacking ally to its owner's hand (when not prepared).
